t: You're at the site of Greenwich District Hospital, a former acute district general hospital in the Maze Hill area of Greenwich. It was built in the 1960s on the site of St Alfege's Hospital, on the east side of Vanbrugh Hill, south of the junction with Woolwich Road. Tom Watkins was born here in 1949. He became a pop impresario who managed Pet Shop Boys, Bros and East 17, and he also designed record sleeves through his agency XL Design.
